title: Principal's groups changed
description: A sign-in brought a person's principal other groups from the identity provider than it had, compared as sets; roles come from groups (HUM-02, AUD-01). The identity provider decides the groups: the person who signed in only carried them. The first sign-in records its groups in whitetower.principal.created.v1 instead.

actor.description: The person whose sign-in carried the groups, or the break-glass custodian.

method.description: The sign-in that carried the groups: from a browser through the identity provider, or the CLI's exchange of an ID token. A break-glass sign-in gives its principal no groups, and records a change only if its principal had some.

before.description: The groups the principal had: sorted, each once.

after.description: The groups the principal has now: sorted, each once.
